newsitem.title: USA: Guidant in alliance with Neuroperfusion.
newsitem.headline: Guidant in alliance with Neuroperfusion.

text.p: Guidant Corp said Monday it entered a strategic alliance with Neuroperfusion Inc, a development-stage company pursuing a novel device therapy for stroke.
Under the agreement, Guidant will invest an undisclosed amount in Neuroperfusion for an equity stake and will get a seat on Neuroperfusion's board of directors.
Other terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
In addition to Guidant's investment, Neuroperfusion raised venture capital financing from a syndicate consisting of Mayfield Fund and New Enterprise Associates, the companies said.
Neuroperfusion is developing a catheter-based approach for treating victims of acute ischemic stroke. Ischemic stroke occurs when an artery supplying blood to the brain is blocked by a clot.
With Neuroperfusion's technology, oxygenated blood is pumped in a reverse direction into veins in the brain.

"Our device has the potential to sustain a patient for extended periods of time until either the blockage clears on its own or until a secondary interventional treatment is introduced to remove the arterial blockage," William Worthen, president Neuroperfusion, a privately held company in Irvine, Calif., said in a statement.
Guidant provides products and services to the global cardiology and minimally invasive surgery marketplaces.
